title: ACQUISITION BY THE NORWEGIAN INVESTMENT FUND FOR DEVELOPING COUNTRIES (NORFUND) OF INDIRECT CONTROL OF COBB EAST AFRICA LIMITED THROUGH ACQUISITION OF 34.67 PERCENT SHARES IN BUCHAN LIMITED
title_sw: ACQUISITION BY THE NORWEGIAN INVESTMENT FUND FOR DEVELOPING COUNTRIES (NORFUND) OF INDIRECT CONTROL OF COBB EAST AFRICA LIMITED THROUGH ACQUISITION OF 34.67 PERCENT SHARES IN BUCHAN LIMITED
text:
The Norwegian Investment Fund for Developing Countries (“NORFUND”) notified the Fair Competition Commission (“FCC”) of their intention to acquire indirect control of Cobb East Africa Limited through acquisition of 34.67 percent shares in Buchan Limited. 
The relevant market was defined as the commercial production and sale of poultry parent stock in Mainland Tanzania. 
Upon analysis, it was concluded that pre- and post-merger scenarios will remain the same for both perspectives of Section 5 (6) (a) and (b) of the Fair Competition Act, 2003, and thus having no possibility of either creating or strengthening a position of dominance in the relevant market. The merger was approved.
